```renyi
public function describe(shape: Shape) returns Text
  purpose: One line naming the shape and giving its area.
  example: describe(Point) is "a point with area 0.00"
  example: describe(Rectangle(width: 2, height: 3)) is "a 2 by 3 rectangle with area 6.00"

  let shape_name be
    match shape
      when Circle(radius) then "a circle of radius {radius}"
      when Rectangle(width, height) then "a {width} by {height} rectangle"
      when Point then "a point"
    end

  let scaled_area be shape.area() * 100.00
  let rounded_cents be scaled_area.rounded()
  let rounded_area be rounded_cents.to_decimal() / 100.00
  let raw_area be rounded_area.to_text()

  match raw_area.index_of(".")
    when some(point_index) then
      let whole_part be raw_area.take(point_index)
      let decimal_part be raw_area.drop(point_index + 1)

      if decimal_part.length() is 0 then
        return "{shape_name} with area {whole_part}.00"
      otherwise if decimal_part.length() is 1 then
        return "{shape_name} with area {whole_part}.{decimal_part}0"
      otherwise
        let two_digits be decimal_part.take(2)
        return "{shape_name} with area {whole_part}.{two_digits}"
      end
    when nothing then return "{shape_name} with area {raw_area}.00"
  end
end
```

```renyi
public function describe(shape: Shape) returns Text
  purpose: One line naming the shape and giving its area.
  example: describe(Point) is "a point with area 0.00"
  example: describe(Rectangle(width: 2, height: 3)) is "a 2 by 3 rectangle with area 6.00"

  let cents be (shape.area() * 100).rounded()
  let whole be cents.quotient(100)
  let fraction be cents remainder 100
  let area_text be if fraction is less than 10 then "{whole}.0{fraction}" otherwise "{whole}.{fraction}" end

  match shape
    when Circle(radius) then return "a circle of radius {radius} with area {area_text}"
    when Rectangle(width, height) then return "a {width} by {height} rectangle with area {area_text}"
    when Point then return "a point with area {area_text}"
  end
end
```

```renyi
public function describe(shape: Shape) returns Text
  purpose: One line naming the shape and giving its area.
  example: describe(Point) is "a point with area 0.00"
  example: describe(Rectangle(width: 2, height: 3)) is "a 2 by 3 rectangle with area 6.00"

  let scaled_area be (shape.area() * 100.00).rounded().to_decimal() / 100.00
  let raw_area be scaled_area.to_text()
  let mutable area_text be raw_area
  if raw_area.contains(".") then
    let area_parts be raw_area.split(".")
    let whole_part be area_parts.first() otherwise crash with "area text has no whole part"
    let remaining_parts be area_parts.rest()
    let fraction_part be remaining_parts.first() otherwise ""
    let fraction_two be if fraction_part.length() is 0 then "00" otherwise if fraction_part.length() is 1 then "{fraction_part}0" otherwise fraction_part.take(2) end
    set area_text to "{whole_part}.{fraction_two}"
  otherwise
    set area_text to "{raw_area}.00"
  end

  match shape
    when Circle(radius) then return "a circle of radius {radius} with area {area_text}"
    when Rectangle(width, height) then return "a {width} by {height} rectangle with area {area_text}"
    when Point then return "a point with area {area_text}"
  end
end
```

```renyi
public function describe(shape: Shape) returns Text
  purpose: One line naming the shape and giving its area.
  example: describe(Point) is "a point with area 0.00"
  example: describe(Rectangle(width: 2, height: 3)) is "a 2 by 3 rectangle with area 6.00"

  let area be shape.area()
  let scaled_area be area * 100.00
  let rounded_area be scaled_area.rounded().to_decimal() / 100.00
  let mutable area_text be rounded_area.to_text()

  if area_text.contains(".") then
    let pieces be area_text.split(".")
    let whole be pieces.at(0) otherwise crash with "area text has no whole part"
    let fraction be pieces.at(1) otherwise crash with "area text has no fraction part"

    if fraction.length() is 0 then
      set area_text to "{whole}.00"
    otherwise if fraction.length() is 1 then
      set area_text to "{whole}.{fraction}0"
    otherwise
      set area_text to "{whole}.{fraction.take(2)}"
    end
  otherwise
    set area_text to "{area_text}.00"
  end

  match shape
    when Circle(radius) then return "a circle of radius {radius} with area {area_text}"
    when Rectangle(width, height) then return "a {width} by {height} rectangle with area {area_text}"
    when Point then return "a point with area {area_text}"
  end
end
```
